title.narrative: Operating a dialysis center in the city of Al-Ghaydah in Al-Mahra Governorate (the third phase)

description.narrative: Operating an integrated center for treating patients with renal failure through hemodialysis in Al-Ghaydah District. It is considered the only specialized center of its kind in the region and is responsible for providing dialysis services.

Providing specialized health care services for patients with kidney failure and preserving their lives by providing blood filtration sessions and activating the center built by the Saudi Program for the Development and Reconstruction of Yemen, as a continuation of the Saudi humanitarian efforts in supporting the Yemeni brothers, improving the level of health services provided to patients with kidney failure, improving and localizing them, and supporting the infrastructure in the sector. Health care, providing the necessary and free treatment to preserve the lives of patients with kidney failure (dialysis sessions - supportive medications), and reducing the number of deaths among patients with kidney failure.

The center continues to be prepared to receive (820) kidney failure patients/provide free treatment and dialysis services for kidney failure patients at a rate of (3) weekly sessions, with a total number of sessions (9600) sessions through the contracted staff, numbering (47) employees, and to maintain the localization of the service and the absence of immigration.
